name: StratSim Management
description: Commercial strategic management simulation for automotive and other industries. Teams compete as rival firms making marketing, R&D, and operational decisions with emergent competitive market dynamics. Used in MBA and executive education programs.
evaluation_method: market share, financial performance, strategic positioning metrics
general_score_metric: cumulative profit (financial performance) and market share (strategic outcome measures)
notes: Primarily used for automotive industry simulation but available for other industries. Used in MBA and executive education.
